sentences.en: Sometimes hockey players get so competitive that fights break out.
sentences.zh: 有时候曲棍球运动员竞争得太激烈以至于会发生打斗。

sentences.en: Did you break the window on purpose or by accident?
sentences.zh: 是你故意打破窗户的吗？还是不小心弄破的？

sentences.en: All humanity will suffer if a nuclear war breaks out.
sentences.zh: 如果爆发核战争，全人类都会受害。
